title: The tests cover the search cases the sweep ran
body:
The differential sweep was an untracked script from the 2026-11-02 refactor survey. It ran the CLI 7,376 times over every fixture and compared stdout, exit codes and `.sufr` bytes between two commits. Jack dropped it on 2026-11-03 and narrowed the rule in `CLAUDE.md` to construction and search results. The CLI's wording is no longer pinned, so only the sweep rows that would have shown a wrong result are worth a test. Those rows, against what `sufr/tests/cli.rs` and the `libsufr` unit tests cover today:

| case | sweep | tests today |
|---|---|---|
| `extract` with `-p` larger than the distance to the sequence start | `-p 100` on every fixture | `-p 1` on a hit at position 0, in cli.rs `extract_seq1_prefix_1` and search.rs `test_extract`; a clamp by more than one byte is untested |
| `extract -s 0` | on every fixture | none; `after` is `Some(3)`, `Some(10)`, `Some(12)` or `None` everywhere |
| queries holding `N` or `$` | N, T$A, ACGTNNACGT$ on every fixture | none; on fixture 1, `$` and `ACGTNNACGT$` each count 1 |
| search on the N-run fixture 3 and on abba | count, locate, extract | `count_seq3` in cli.rs; a library locate on abba |

## Proposal

- A `libsufr` unit test for `extraction` with `before` past the sequence start and `after: Some(0)`, on a multi-sequence fixture.
- A decision on whether a query holding the sentinel matches it, then one test for whichever answer.
- `locate` and `extract` tests on fixture 3 and on abba, with expected output written by hand from the text.

## Out of scope

- sufr-2fd179 holds the `seq_end` bug that the TODO in `extraction` marks. Its test comes with its fix.
- The sweep's CLI rows, missing files, unwritable `-o` and `list` rank errors, were dropped with the rule.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/1ddc0e5b
notes.text: Jack decided on 2026-11-03 that this runs after the code changes already on the board, not before. A ranked list of the gaps that matter is being drawn up in conversation; the rows Jack picks from it become the scope, and the table in the body is the full inventory, not the plan.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/1ddc0e5b
notes.text: Rescoped on 2026-11-03 after Jack narrowed the CLAUDE.md rule to construction and search results. The body holds the scope. The sweep script and the memory benchmark-and-sweep-scripts were deleted the same day.
